title: Women's College extern closes Nov 20 (format C revision, not published)

slides.title: women's college extern posting: what to know before it closes

slides.label: extern notes 📝
slides.title: who can apply
slides.body: BScN students. the posting doesn't name a year. BCLS certification is required.

slides.title: the pay is $20.60/hr
slides.body: up to 7.5 hours a week, as posted.

slides.title: it closes friday, nov 20
slides.body: don't leave it to the last night.

slides.title: before you hit submit
slides.body: check you're in a BScN program, have your BCLS details ready, update your resume and screenshot your confirmation.

slides.title: looking for more extern postings?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca: Ontario extern postings, checked on each hospital's own careers page.

caption.text:
Women’s College Hospital’s clinical extern posting closes Nov 20, 2026: BScN, BCLS required, $20.60/hr, up to 7.5 hours per week (as posted). Full requirements are on the hospital’s posting.

ontarioexterns.ca is our own independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
